name: @dsh-plugin/ego-publish
description: Agent-driven publishing on top of ego lite: isolated browser profiles per account, a shared proxy pool assigned per account, persistent logins, replayable publish flows, and a Web UI
comment: Host half plus a hand-written Web client half, no runtime dependencies. The plugin drives the installed ego lite binary over CDP (no Playwright, no engine process). The client bundle requests only `react`, which the shell seeds.
